'''Godon Netakka''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] in the period following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He tracked down [[Bandin Dobah]], an [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] operating on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Formos/Legends|Formos]]. Dobah succeeded in convincing him to join his gang. [[Zukata]], his sister, arrived on Formos to find what happened to him. A group of adventurers, on the trail of Dobah, found him on [[Bandin Dobah's asteroid base]].
